items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: Was Tom Anderson married to Gertrude Dix?

ctx.x: I practically played both sides of the... Yeah, I played both of them. Because you see on the other side on Ramport Street, every time... Every birthday he had, he celebrated birthday. Right. And he'd get the band in there. Yeah. Yeah. To have a big time. That old man... He was an old man, but he just was spoke. He had plenty of money too. He was rich. Yeah. Get a crowd of women and everything in there and have his band and note and champagne and stuff. We'd have a time back up in there.
Was he married to Gertrude Dix? Do you remember? And one of the... We had one of the houses and the madam went next door. Do you remember? Who? Was Tom Anderson married to Gertrude Dix?
